'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Aaron Kinser LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kinser]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
